name: 空间转录组 GEF 转 GEM

description_en: DCS Cloud WDL "SAW-ST-V8-gef2gem" (v1.2.0) parameter guide: convert SAW GEF spatial expression matrices to GEM text matrices (Square Bin or Cellbin).
